packageRules.description: Each upstream/solr6/* directory pins one deliberate ASS release; bumping it would silently change which version that image builds
This project deliberately builds images for solr v6, prevent renovate from updating to v10.x
4.14.0 is the last LocalStack release that runs without a LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN. Later releases use calendar versioning (2026.03.0+) and require an account token.
